subject: Floating indicators
notes: kb/Work PB1492 / PB1359 landed: the first nonblank character of EVERY continuation line (the fixed indicator's and the floating one's, in both reference formats) shall be the quotation symbol that opened the literal, else COBOL2684; the literal state carries the opening quotation symbol across lines (PB1491), so an apostrophe inside a quotation-mark literal continued by the fixed indicator is content (85/pb1492_continued_literal_other_quote_content).
